newsitem.title: USA: Citicorp files for $1 million shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp files for $1 million shelf offer.

text.p: Citicorp said Monday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1 million in subordinated debt securities and preferred securities.

The preferred securites are unconditionally guaranteed by Citicorp and will be sold from time to time by Citicorp Capital I, Citcorp Capital II, Citicorp Capital III and Citicorp Capital IV, the filing said.

Net proceeds will be applied to Citicorp's general funds to be used by its management for corporation purposes, principally to fund investments in, or extensions of credit to, banking and non-banking subsidiaries, the filing said.
Citicorp, whose principal subsidiary is CitiBank N.A., is a holding company located in New York City.
